fields.description: Issue features editorials and reporting on a newspaper strike and public opinion (including reference to President Truman), criticism of the Florida East Coast Railway’s response to the death of employee-hero William “Buck” Weaver, and advocacy for municipal ownership/control of the Florida Power & Light electricity franchise. Coverage also includes Miami city commission actions regarding state railroad commission authority over municipal bus lines, concerns about diesel bus exhaust and smoke nuisances, notes on tax bills/exemptions, flood control needs in Florida, local court/crime items, and entertainment/nightlife columns and advertisements.
